meaning: None other than / Nothing but / Definitely is
mnemonicOrNote: Asserts conclusively that the subject is nothing other than X.
exampleJapanese: 彼の成功は、長年の努力の結果にほかならない。
exampleReading: かれのせいこうは、ながねんのどりょくのけっかにほかならない。
exampleRomaji: Kare no seikou wa, naganen no doryoku no kekka ni hokanaranai.
exampleEnglish: His success is nothing other than the result of years of effort.

meaning: on the occasion of, at the time of
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun + に際して / Verb [Dictionary] + に際して. Formal expression used for important milestone occasions.
exampleJapanese: 新事業の開始に際してご挨拶を申し上げます。
exampleEnglish: I offer my greetings on the occasion of launching our new venture.

japanese: 〜を契機に (Taking ... as an opportunity/turning point)
meaning: taking as a turning point, as a result of
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun + を契機に / を契機として. Marks a decisive turning point triggering significant development.
exampleJapanese: 留学を契機に日本文学の研究を志しました。
exampleEnglish: Taking study abroad as a turning point, I aspired to research Japanese literature.

japanese: 〜ざるを得ない (Cannot help but... / Forced to)
meaning: cannot help but, forced to do against will
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Verb [ない-stem] + ざるを得ない (する -> せざるを得ない). Indicates no alternative choice remains under circumstances.
exampleJapanese: これ以上の予算超過は計画の中止を認めざるを得ない。
exampleEnglish: With budget overruns beyond this point, we cannot help but concede to canceling the plan.

japanese: 〜をはじめとする (Starting with... and others)
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun + をはじめとする + Noun. Formal presentation of prime representative examples.
exampleJapanese: 東京をはじめとする大都市で人口集中が深刻化しています。
exampleEnglish: Population concentration is becoming severe in metropolitan cities, starting with Tokyo.

japanese: 〜かねない (Could happen / Might lead to bad outcome)
meaning: might, capable of leading to (adverse result)
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Verb [ます-stem] + かねない. Expresses realistic fear or danger of a negative event happening.
exampleJapanese: 過度の労働は重大な健康被害を引き起こしかねない。
exampleEnglish: Excessive labor could lead to serious health harm.

japanese: 〜にほかならない (Nothing other than / Purely)
meaning: is nothing other than, is precisely
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun / Plain form + からにほかならない. Asserts single decisive conclusion without exception.
exampleJapanese: プロジェクトの成功はチーム全員の結束にほかなりません。
exampleEnglish: The success of the project is nothing other than the solidarity of the whole team.
